takeaways: A winter tour of a Key Land Homes model in Whispering Waters, a newer two-story neighborhood in Shakopee with homes from about 2,700 to 4,600 square feet.
Shakopee is about 20 to 30 minutes from the airport and under 35 minutes from downtown via Highway 169 and I-494.

The main floor has 9-foot ceilings, a wide living room with a rectangular fireplace, one of the largest kitchen islands Jason has seen (seating five), a big pantry, a coffee bar, a mudroom bench and a tucked-away half bath.

Upstairs are a loft, a small office, laundry with a broom closet and four bedrooms, each with bath access: the owner's suite with a large tiled shower and soaking tub, a bedroom with its own bath, and two sharing a Jack-and-Jill bath.
The unfinished basement has room for another bedroom and living space, for close to 4,600 finished square feet in all.

faq.q: How big are the homes in Whispering Waters in Shakopee?
faq.a: From about 2,700 square feet to about 4,600 square feet with the basement finished, according to the video.

takeaways: A listing tour, with Jason and Brooke Huerkamp, of a fully updated Lakeville home: five bedrooms, five baths, a four-car garage and about 5,400 square feet, about a mile from I-35W yet with a private, wooded backyard.

The main floor has a two-story entry with ceilings of about 16 feet, an executive office, refinished maple floors, a gas fireplace, a formal dining room and a white kitchen with a built-in coffee maker, double ovens and a six-burner GE Monogram cooktop with griddle.

Outdoor living: a pergola-covered deck, a screened porch, an in-ground pool 9 feet deep with a diving board and a newer liner, a privacy fence, a poolside bar plumbed for a grill, and a separate hot tub room.

Upstairs are four bedrooms with walk-in closets, an updated owner's suite and a hidden, soundproofed home theater off the owner's closet. The lower level adds a wet bar, a gas fireplace, a family room and a pool table area. The home also has central vacuum.

faq.q: Are there homes with pools in Lakeville?
faq.a: Yes, though they're less common in Minnesota. This updated Lakeville home has a 9-foot-deep in-ground pool, a diving board and a separate hot tub room.

takeaways: A tour of a new five-bedroom, three-bath Lakeville home with a three-car garage and about 2,500 finished square feet, priced around $690,000 at the time, near Pilot Knob Road with easy access to Cedar Avenue and I-35W.

The main floor has 9-foot ceilings, a covered front porch, a three-quarter bath set away from the living areas, an electric fireplace, matte-finish countertops, a kitchen island with glass-front cabinets, and an office that counts as the fifth bedroom.
Upstairs are four bedrooms, laundry with green upper cabinets, a hall bath with the tub and toilet behind a separate door, and an owner's suite with a tiled shower and a wraparound closet.
The unfinished walkout basement is roughed in for a family room, another bedroom and a bath. Jason had just sold the same floor plan to clients in Savage.

faq.q: What does about $690,000 buy in new construction in Lakeville?
faq.a: In this tour, about 2,500 finished square feet with five bedrooms (one on the main floor), three baths, a three-car garage and an unfinished walkout basement.

takeaways: A tour of D.R. Horton's Whitney plan at Caramore Crossing in Rosemount, a neighborhood close to shopping.
About 3,400 square feet with five bedrooms, four baths and a three-car garage, priced around $690,000 at the time.

The main floor has a dining room, wide hallways, a gourmet kitchen package with KitchenAid appliances and a five-burner cooktop, a pantry, a coffee bar, a fireplace, smart-home controls and a main-floor bedroom with a three-quarter bath.

Upstairs are a large loft, laundry, an owner's suite with two closets and a soaking tub, a Jack-and-Jill bath and an unusually large secondary bedroom. Finishing the walkout basement adds about 1,200 square feet for roughly $40,000, according to the video.

faq.q: What does about $690,000 buy in new construction in Rosemount?
faq.a: In this tour, about 3,400 square feet with five bedrooms (one on the main floor), four baths, a three-car garage and an unfinished walkout basement.

takeaways: A listing tour, with Jason and Brooke Huerkamp, of an 1885 brownstone in Saint Paul's Cathedral Hill area: just over 3,000 square feet with three bedrooms, three baths and a two-car garage.
Rebuilt down to the studs, it pairs original brick walls and arches with white walls, curved walls, recessed lighting and skylights for a gallery-like feel.

Four levels: a finished basement family room, a main floor with a stacked-stone wood-burning fireplace and maple floors, a second floor with a two-story space over the dining area, two bedrooms and a laundry, and a top-floor owner's suite with ceilings of about 14 to 16 feet.
The owner's level opens to a rooftop patio, rare among the area's historic brownstones, and there are three wood-burning fireplaces in all.

faq.q: Are there brownstones in Saint Paul?
faq.a: Yes. The Cathedral Hill and Summit Avenue area has historic brownstones and row houses from the 1880s, some fully renovated like this one.

takeaways: A February tour of a Key Land Homes villa in Pheasant Run in Lakeville: four bedrooms, three baths, a two-car garage and almost 3,000 square feet, available with or without a finished basement.

One-level living on the main floor: 9-foot ceilings, a large office, a mudroom, a full bath, a big kitchen island with two granite finishes, a herringbone backsplash, a five-burner range, a coffee bar and very large windows.
The owner's suite is on the main floor next to the laundry, with double sinks, a walk-in tiled shower and a large closet. The home backs up to a park, so no one will build behind it.
The finished walkout lower level adds a second living area, two bedrooms, a bath and a storage room of roughly 15 by 25 feet that could become a theater or gym.

faq.q: Are there new villa homes in Lakeville?
faq.a: Yes. Key Land Homes builds villas in Lakeville's Pheasant Run with the owner's suite and laundry on the main floor, plus an optional finished lower level.
